senses.caution: About other people's work it sounds dismissive. Even about your own work be careful, because people remember when a trivial change breaks something.
senses.definition: So small or easy that it is not worth spending time on.

senses.caution: It suits technical readers. With senior leaders give a number right after it, and use it only when you have actually estimated the work.
senses.definition: Not simple, and harder or larger than the person asking has assumed.
